Trial and error learning is defined as an attempt to solve a problem by trying various alternatives until the right solution is found. Sometimes trial and error learning is necessary.�But the disadvantage is that a lot of time is wasted until the learner stumbles upon the correct answer.�It is time consuming and also can be very frustrating.�The learners must devise ways of keeping track of discarded possibilities so they don t start going in circles and repeating mistakes.
